card: ROLE: Off-screen command faction; never appeared directly — known only through Honorata's confession to Othon
ROLE: Architects of a dynastic succession conspiracy aimed at seizing the Imperial throne
TRAIT: Dispatched Honorata, a Shabda-Oud priestess, to seduce Othon and produce a mandated hermaphrodite heir — a 'perfect androgyne' — from his blood
TRAIT: Intended to present the androgyne heir to gain majority planetary support and secure the throne
TRAIT: Planned to seize the Imperial throne by poisoning Janus-Jana as the linchpin of their scheme
TRAIT: Planned to remove the child from its parents at age seven to raise as their political instrument
TRAIT: Their law mandates assassination of parents, child, and all associates if a forbidden birth is exposed

RELATIONSHIP: honorata__living (Honorata, Living Priestess): the agent they dispatched; she defied their order and bore a male son instead of the mandated androgyne; whether that defection ended their succession plan is unresolved
RELATIONSHIP: janus-jana (Janus-Jana): their intended assassination target; her poisoning was the mechanism for the planned throne seizure
VOICE: No direct voice; known entirely through Honorata's confession to Othon — they speak only through the orders she chose to betray
BOUNDARY: No confirmed visual appearance or direct speech at any point in the story
BOUNDARY: Whether their succession plot targeting Janus-Jana remained active after Honorata's defection is unresolved
source_strategy: Single extracted record, Volume 4 page 12. Thin off-screen faction — referenced only in Honorata's confession to Othon. Card kept compact and source-bounded. Speculative Shabda-Oud command-stratum claim removed; affiliation restated only as the supported fact that Honorata, the agent they held authority over, was a Shabda-Oud priestess. Honorata relationship now points at honorata__living and softened to not assert the succession plan was conclusively ended.
